get.summary: Get the Nodes, Edges, Annotations, and Tags of a shared Canvas
get.description: Open to anyone who has the share link ID, with or without a session, so a Canvas can be shared by URL. Returns the Canvas as it is now, the same graph its owner reads; trashed nodes, edges, and annotations are never included. The share routes are read-only.

400.description: The share_id is not a UUID

404.description: The share link does not exist or its Canvas is trashed

get.summary: Get the underlying data entity for a Node of a shared Canvas
get.description: Open to anyone who has the share link ID. Returns the underlying data-pool entity (the signed SummaryNode) for a Canvas Node. The node must belong to the Canvas the share link points at and have Translator data, and that Canvas must not be trashed; otherwise the response is 404.

200.description: The underlying data entity for the node

400.description: The share_id is not a UUID or the id is not an integer

404.description: The share link does not exist, its Canvas is trashed, or the Canvas has no such node with Translator data

get.summary: Get the underlying data entity for an Edge of a shared Canvas
get.description: Open to anyone who has the share link ID. Returns the underlying data-pool entity (the signed SummaryEdge) for a Canvas Edge. The edge must belong to the Canvas the share link points at and have Translator data, and that Canvas must not be trashed; otherwise the response is 404.

200.description: The underlying data entity for the edge

400.description: The share_id is not a UUID or the id is not an integer

404.description: The share link does not exist, its Canvas is trashed, or the Canvas has no such edge with Translator data
